initialPrompts.wrap:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset: production transparent RGBA fantasy game VFX animation sprite sheet, ONLY energy, no character.
Create a refined royal combat aura wrapping around an invisible upright adult armored knight. One sheet exactly FOUR columns by THREE rows (12 equally sized square cells), landscape 4:3 ratio. No visible grid, labels, text or marks.
Each cell has one centered full-body vertical aura with SAME footprint and scale: slender upward curling ribbons at left and right, spiralling crossing wisps near the lower legs and waist, thin upward streams on shoulder sides, a few small drifting embers. It must feel like energy continuously embracing a standing human from feet to helmet while the CENTER remains substantially transparent and readable. Not a spinning vortex or explosive spell. Do not draw body, face, armor, weapon, animal, background or ground.
Twelve genuinely distinct consecutive hand-painted animation frames in a seamless calm 2.4-second loop: stream shapes coil and rise, small ribbons split and reunite, particles drift, frame 12 returns naturally to frame 1. Fluid organic tapered shapes, restrained opacity, smooth elegant strokes with crisp edges. An elite final-tier knight aura, substantial enough to read around a small on-screen sprite, never a white fog covering the subject.
Neutral pearl-white / silver-gray luminous energy only, intended for engine tinting into deep crimson and champagne gold. No chromatic colors. Moderately bright strokes, translucent inner gradients; no opaque white masses.
Compositional constraints: every cell has at least 18% genuinely empty transparent padding on ALL FOUR SIDES; energy wholly isolated in its cell, no adjacent-cell overlap. Same center and invisible human-sized hollow space. True alpha background including the central hollow; no black, gray or checkerboard background. No floor shadow, no vignette, no environment.
initialPrompts.rear:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset: production transparent RGBA fantasy game VFX animation sprite sheet, ONLY rear aura, no character.
Create a noble diffuse backlight aura for an elite black-and-gold armored knight: a vertical flame-like halo surrounding an invisible body, with a crown of short thin radiating light rays centered behind the upper back and shoulders, and two soft tapering wisps descending along the body's sides toward the feet. The character-sized middle remains open and low opacity so foreground armor will be clearly visible. Elegant imperial presence, calm power, not angel wings, not a solid disc, not a magical text circle, no animal.
One sheet exactly FOUR columns by THREE rows: 12 equally sized square cells, 4:3 landscape. Same aura center, footprint and scale in all cells. Twelve genuinely different sequential frames forming a smooth continuous 2.4-second breathing loop. Rays slowly change shape, wisps drift upward, a few tiny sparks float; no huge bursts, no abrupt flashing.
High-quality painterly 2D fantasy game VFX. Neutral pearl-white and silver-gray ONLY, intended for engine tinting. Luminous slender spokes with soft halos, fine layered flame filaments at the silhouette edges. Open central area, medium opacity and controlled highlights, no brilliant opaque white blob.
Every cell must keep at least 18% fully transparent blank margin on all sides. Aura must stay wholly inside each cell. Genuinely transparent background and central hollow. No character, weapon, animal, text, captions, frame borders, grid lines, checkerboard, background scene or ground shadow.

spacingEditPrompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit target: this 4 columns x 3 rows transparent aura sprite sheet. Correct the contact sheet SPACING ONLY. Keep 12 different consecutive aura frames and the same general energy style, but shrink EACH INDIVIDUAL AURA to 55% of its current width AND height and place it at the exact center of its own unchanged equal cell. Every frame must have huge empty transparent gaps around it: at least 22% blank margin above, below, left and right. There must be no energy crossing a cell boundary, and no cropping at the sheet edges. In particular show the full top tip and full bottom tip of every aura, with clear space. Remove all horizontal lines or separators. Preserve true alpha; center holes and gaps remain completely transparent. Do NOT add a background or character or grid. All 12 frames remain distinct. The desired result is intentionally a spacious sheet of SMALL isolated effects in a large transparent canvas, NOT large effects filling the grid. Output landscape 4:3 canvas. Neutral pearl-white/grayscale energy only.
packing: 4x3 atlas, 12 unique frames per sheet, original alpha, uniform sheet-wide scaling and cell registration. No redraw or recolor of raster assets.
